Tells the agent which command stopped a restack; nothing runs it. The restack itself runs through HostGit (StackGit is the PR service's HostGit runner).

The relay runner is a standalone program on a dedicated runner machine, outside Volt's desktop and server hosts. The agent it starts runs unsandboxed there with the same rights as this git, so HostGit's guards would not add a boundary; it cannot import src/vs either.
